in_game_description: Although no longer classified as hazardous, radioactive goods are still unpopular. Perhaps it is the yellow symbol or the strong lights that make people associate them with danger?
mechanics_text: Required for blueprints: 10t Ion Lambda MK2, 15t Liberator, 40t AMR Extinctor, 40t Yin Co. Shadow Ninja.
Always sold at Sao Perula in the Loma system; large quantities available depending on difficulty.
Shares the same container as Biowaste but is yellow with a radioactive symbol instead of orange with a biohazard symbol.
